bug_semantics: ncu prints dependency homepage and repository URL strings from a package's package.json into the upgrades table without stripping terminal control characters. A crafted homepage or repository field (reachable via --format homepage or --format repo, originally --output repositoryLink) injects OSC/CSI/control sequences into stdout when a developer runs ncu, enabling terminal-title or other emulator-dependent output manipulation (CWE-150).
flaw_origin: The first public write of the sink is 43bac8b12f6cdbc121c11cc0839e97d7abba0138 ('Add repo urls to new --output command'). That commit added lib/repo-url.js getRepoUrl() and printed its return value unsanitized in lib/logging.js toDependencyTable() when output includes 'repositoryLink' (later renamed --format repo). For https GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repository strings it returns the raw gitURL; hosted-git-info browse URLs are also returned without control-character stripping. Immediate parent 2ae1ed2d0573d086815dfb7d98e7ecc82aeb0a11 has no getRepoUrl, no lib/repo-url.js, and toDependencyTable only emits dep/from/to/ownerChanged. Later c273d79d7ea5daa2cdf9000120c8f5e7f084017b added an analogous unsanitized homepageUrl cell (--format homepage); 8ac7df2c937130b9b86fa367ba497415ab0351fa loosened getRepoUrl to any http(s) URL. Those expand the same class of sink; they are not the first write. Direct fix b554b84848fc0b08a9d2b3d3db15e351387168cf (PR #1994, closes #1988) wraps homepageUrl, repoUrl, and related registry text in sanitizeForDisplay (stripVTControlCharacters plus C0/C1 strip). CVE-2026-73035 NVD status is Received, not withdrawn/rejected. Tag check: BIC is an ancestor of v10.1.0 and of affected v23.0.2; the fix is not in v23.0.2 and is contained in v23.1.0.
